label: chat
title: Sovereign Website Chat, a variation of Google Chat
description: A Sovereign Website tool: Google Chat for any website, with your own Google sign-in in the browser only, an API at /api/ to read and post in spaces, and a small app. Not affiliated with Google.
conditions: As the Gmail and Drive tools: Sovereign Website brand, no look-alike, no Google logo or trade dress, a not-affiliated notice. OAuth in the browser only, the narrowest Chat scopes that work, read before write; the token in memory, or sessionStorage on opt-in, never localStorage; posting needs the user's confirmation. A CSP limited to self and the Google API hosts it uses. An ABP. A security review before real use. No space, message or person named on the site without consent.
